screen.no_wedges: No wedge values in the sensor

app.name: Camper level
app.summary: A spirit level for your camper: bubble, tilting vans for pitch and roll, and the wedges per wheel.
app.good_hint: Up to this angle the vehicle counts as level: green.
app.warn_hint: Up to this angle amber, above it red.
app.scale_hint: The angle at which the bubble reaches the edge of the ring.
app.gain_hint: How much the vans exaggerate the angle, so a small one shows. 1 is true to life.
app.invert_hint: When the bubble and the van tilt the wrong way, because the sensor is mounted the other way round.
